bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Copilot & Remove Copilot App
bundles.description: Removes the Microsoft Copilot app and disables Windows Copilot shell integration via user and machine policies.
side_effects: Win+C shortcut and Copilot taskbar button are removed.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Recall Policy (AI Snapshots)
bundles.description: Disables Windows AI Data Analysis (Recall continuous screen snapshots) and turns off Saving Snapshots via machine policy.
side_effects: Recall snapshot capture and semantic timeline search are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Windows Recall Payload (DISM Feature)
bundles.description: Disables the Recall optional feature payload via DISM so its AI binaries are unprovisioned from the OS image.
side_effects: Requires a system reboot to finalize DISM feature state.
Re-enabling requires Windows Update or installation media.

bundles.display_name: Disable Click to Do (AI Screen Overlay)
bundles.description: Disables the Windows 11 24H2+ 'Click to Do' interactive AI screen analysis overlay.
side_effects: Win+Click / Snipping Tool Click to Do AI text and image actions are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable AI Features in Microsoft Paint (Cocreator & Image Creator)
bundles.description: Disables Cocreator, Image Creator, and Generative Fill AI features inside Microsoft Paint via policy.
side_effects: AI image generation buttons in Paint are hidden or disabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable AI Rewrite & Summarize in Windows Notepad
bundles.description: Disables Copilot Rewrite / Cowriter AI cloud integration in Windows Notepad.
side_effects: Right-click 'Rewrite with Notepad' and AI credit menu in Notepad are hidden.

bundles.display_name: Disable Microsoft Edge Copilot Sidebar & Page Context AI
bundles.description: Hides the Copilot sidebar hub in Microsoft Edge and blocks Edge from sending active page context to Copilot.
side_effects: Edge sidebar Copilot button and AI compose/summarize prompts are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Copilot+ AI Hub & Windows Dev Home
bundles.description: Removes the preinstalled Microsoft AI Hub and Windows Dev Home apps for all users.
side_effects: Dev Home dashboard and AI Hub showcase app are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Reduce Diagnostic Telemetry & Advertising ID
bundles.description: Lowers diagnostic data collection to the minimum allowed by OS SKU, disables Advertising ID, and disables Customer Experience Improvement Program tasks.
side_effects: Personalized ads and diagnostic feedback frequency are disabled.
Windows Insider builds may require diagnostic data re-enabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable Connected User Experiences and Telemetry Service (DiagTrack)
bundles.description: Sets the DiagTrack background telemetry service startup type to Disabled.
side_effects: Xbox achievements and Microsoft Store error reporting may stop syncing until re-enabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable WAP Push Message Routing Telemetry Service (dmwappushservice)
bundles.description: Disables the Device Management Wireless Application Protocol (WAP) Push message routing service used by telemetry.
side_effects: MDM push notifications on cellular-connected devices may not wake the MDM client.

bundles.display_name: Disable Lock Screen Tips, Fun Facts & Silent Promoted Apps
bundles.description: Stops Windows Content Delivery Manager from silently installing promoted Store apps and showing tips/ads on the lock screen.
side_effects: Windows Spotlight lock screen fun facts and suggested Start menu apps are hidden.

bundles.display_name: Disable Activity History & Cloud Timeline Sync
bundles.description: Disables Windows Activity Feed collection, local activity history publishing, and cloud activity uploads.
side_effects: Cross-device app/document activity history is no longer recorded.

bundles.display_name: Disable System Location Services & Sensor Scripting
bundles.description: Disables Windows Location Provider and location scripting across all apps via machine policy.
side_effects: Weather widgets, Maps, and browser geolocation will not receive automatic OS location coordinates.

bundles.display_name: Disable Find My Device Cloud Location Tracking
bundles.description: Disables periodic cloud location beacon reporting used by Microsoft's Find My Device feature.
side_effects: You will not be able to locate this PC remotely from account.microsoft.com/devices.

bundles.display_name: Disable Tailored Experiences & Inking/Typing Harvesting
bundles.description: Blocks Microsoft from using diagnostic data for tailored tips/ads and stops implicit typing/inking dictionary harvesting.
side_effects: Cloud-personalized tips and cloud handwriting telemetry are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable App Launch Tracking & Settings App Suggestions
bundles.description: Prevents Windows from tracking app launches to reorder Start menu items and hides promoted suggestions inside the Settings app.
side_effects: Start menu 'Most used' app list will no longer track launched executables.

bundles.display_name: Disable Microsoft 365 Ads & OneDrive Nag Banner in Settings
bundles.description: Disables Microsoft 365 / OneDrive subscription upsell banners and post-update 'Welcome Experience' nag screens.
side_effects: Full-screen 'Finish setting up your device' prompts after Windows Updates are suppressed.

bundles.display_name: Disable Microsoft Edge Sponsored Shortcuts, Shopping & Telemetry
bundles.description: Disables sponsored links on the Edge New Tab page, turns off the Edge Shopping Assistant, and disables Edge personalization reporting.
side_effects: Edge New Tab page will not inject sponsored partner tiles or shopping popups.

bundles.display_name: Disable Bing Web Results in Windows Search
bundles.description: Disables Bing web search suggestions in the Start Menu search box so searches stay strictly local and fast.
side_effects: Start Menu search queries will only search local files, apps, and settings.

bundles.display_name: Disable Microsoft Store App Suggestions in 'Open With' & Search
bundles.description: Prevents Windows from prompting to look for an app in the Microsoft Store when opening unknown file extensions.
side_effects: 'Look for an app in the Microsoft Store' dialog option is suppressed.

bundles.display_name: Disable Taskbar Widgets & MSN News Feed (Windows 11)
bundles.description: Disables the Windows 11 Widgets board and background WebExperience news feed via machine policy.
side_effects: Win+W and the taskbar Weather/Widgets icon are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Disable Taskbar 'News and Interests' Weather Feed (Windows 10)
bundles.description: Disables the Windows 10 'News and Interests' taskbar weather/news flyout via user setting and machine policy.
side_effects: Windows 10 taskbar weather widget and MSN news flyout are hidden.

bundles.display_name: Align Windows 11 Taskbar Icons to the Left
bundles.description: Moves the Start button and pinned taskbar icons from the center of the screen back to the classic left corner.
side_effects: Taskbar alignment changes from Center to Left.

bundles.display_name: Hide Search Box / Icon from Taskbar
bundles.description: Hides the Search box/button from the taskbar (you can still search at any time by pressing the Windows key and typing).
side_effects: Taskbar search button is hidden; press Win key or Win+S to search.

bundles.display_name: Show Compact Search Icon Only on Taskbar
bundles.description: Replaces the wide taskbar search bar with a compact magnifying glass icon.
side_effects: Taskbar search box shrinks to an icon-only button.

bundles.display_name: Hide Task View (Virtual Desktops) Button from Taskbar
bundles.description: Hides the Task View button on the taskbar (Win+Tab shortcut still works).
side_effects: Task View icon is hidden from the taskbar.

bundles.display_name: Hide Chat (Personal Teams) & 'Meet Now' Icon from Taskbar
bundles.description: Hides the consumer Teams Chat icon on Windows 11 and the Skype 'Meet Now' system tray icon on Windows 10.
side_effects: Consumer Chat / Meet Now taskbar buttons are hidden.

bundles.display_name: Disable Start Menu 'Recommended' Section & Recent File Tracking
bundles.description: Disables Start Menu 'Recommended' tips/promotions and stops tracking recently opened documents in Start and Jump Lists.
side_effects: Start menu 'Recommended' feed and recent document suggestions are cleared.

bundles.display_name: Disable Phone Link Companion Flyout in Start Menu
bundles.description: Hides the mobile Phone Link companion sidebar attached to the right side of the Windows 11 Start Menu.
side_effects: Start menu no longer shows the Phone Link status pane next to Start.

bundles.display_name: Enable 'End Task' Option in Taskbar Right-Click Menu
bundles.description: Adds an 'End task' command directly when right-clicking any app icon on the Windows 11 taskbar without opening Task Manager.
side_effects: Right-clicking any running app on the taskbar shows 'End task'.

bundles.display_name: Enable 'Last Active Click' Window Cycling on Taskbar Icons
bundles.description: Clicking an app icon with multiple open windows immediately switches to the last active window instead of requiring a second click on the thumbnail preview.
side_effects: Clicking a grouped taskbar icon cycles directly between its open windows.

bundles.display_name: Never Combine Taskbar Buttons & Show Window Labels
bundles.description: Configures the primary and multi-monitor taskbars to never combine window buttons and always show window title labels.
side_effects: Each open window gets its own labeled taskbar button.

bundles.display_name: Restore Classic Windows 10 Right-Click Context Menu
bundles.description: Restores the full right-click context menu in File Explorer and Desktop without needing to click 'Show more options'.
side_effects: Replaces the compact Windows 11 context menu with the full classic shell menu.

bundles.display_name: Always Show File Extensions in File Explorer
bundles.description: Configures File Explorer to always display known file type extensions (prevents '.pdf.exe' spoofing).
side_effects: All files in Explorer show their full extension (e.g. .exe, .txt, .json).

bundles.display_name: Show Hidden Files and Folders in File Explorer
bundles.description: Configures File Explorer to show hidden files and folders such as AppData and dotfiles.
side_effects: Hidden files and folders (e.g., AppData) are visible in File Explorer.

bundles.display_name: Open File Explorer to 'This PC' Instead of Home / Quick Access
bundles.description: Sets the default startup view of File Explorer (Win+E) to 'This PC' (drives and folders) instead of the Home / Quick Access feed.
side_effects: Opening a new File Explorer window starts at 'This PC'.

bundles.display_name: Hide 'Home' and 'Gallery' from File Explorer Navigation Pane
bundles.description: Unpins the 'Gallery' and 'Home' cloud-integrated items from the left navigation sidebar in Windows 11 File Explorer.
side_effects: Gallery and Home nodes are hidden from the File Explorer left sidebar.

bundles.display_name: Hide OneDrive from File Explorer Navigation Pane
bundles.description: Unpins the OneDrive cloud folder entry from the File Explorer left navigation tree.
side_effects: OneDrive icon is hidden from the File Explorer sidebar.

bundles.display_name: Hide Duplicate Removable USB Drives in Explorer Sidebar
bundles.description: Prevents removable USB drives from appearing twice in the File Explorer navigation pane (once under 'This PC' and again at the bottom).
side_effects: Removable drives appear only under 'This PC' in the navigation pane.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows 11 Top-of-Screen File Drag Share Tray
bundles.description: Disables the Windows 11 'Drag Tray' share overlay that drops down from the top of the screen whenever you drag a file.
side_effects: Dragging a file near the top of the screen no longer triggers the Share bar.

bundles.display_name: Show Drive Letters Before Drive Names (e.g. '(C:) Local Disk')
bundles.description: Displays drive letters at the beginning of drive labels in File Explorer for faster scanning by power users.
side_effects: Drives display as '(C:) Local Disk' instead of 'Local Disk (C:)'.

bundles.display_name: Hide 'Give access to', 'Include in library' & 'Share' Context Menu Items
bundles.description: Removes legacy 'Give access to', 'Include in library', and modern 'Share' clutter from File Explorer right-click menus.
side_effects: Right-click menu is cleaner and loads faster.

bundles.display_name: Hide '3D Objects' Folder from This PC (Windows 10)
bundles.description: Hides the unused '3D Objects' special folder from 'This PC' and the File Explorer navigation pane on Windows 10.
side_effects: The 3D Objects folder is hidden from This PC view.

bundles.display_name: Enable System & App Dark Mode
bundles.description: Sets both Windows shell surfaces (Taskbar/Start) and Win32/UWP app themes to Dark Mode.
side_effects: Switches current user theme from Light to Dark.

bundles.display_name: Disable Window & Taskbar Transparency Effects (Mica / Acrylic)
bundles.description: Disables Acrylic/Mica blur transparency across the Taskbar, Start Menu, and Settings windows to reduce DWM GPU overhead.
side_effects: Window backgrounds become solid opaque surfaces.

bundles.display_name: Disable Taskbar & Window Transition Animations
bundles.description: Disables taskbar sliding animations and window minimize/maximize animations for snappy UI responsiveness.
side_effects: Windows and menus open and close instantaneously without fade/slide transitions.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Spotlight Desktop Wallpaper & 'Learn About This Picture' Icon
bundles.description: Removes the permanent 'Learn about this picture' icon from the Desktop and disables Windows Spotlight desktop wallpaper collection.
side_effects: 'Learn about this picture' desktop icon is removed.

bundles.display_name: Show Only Open Windows (No Browser Tabs) in Alt+Tab
bundles.description: Prevents Microsoft Edge from flooding the Alt+Tab window switcher with individual browser tabs.
side_effects: Alt+Tab only cycles between actual application windows.

bundles.display_name: Disable Sticky Keys (5x Shift) & Filter Keys Popup Prompts
bundles.description: Disables the disruptive Sticky Keys and Filter Keys modal prompts when pressing Shift rapidly in games or editors.
side_effects: Pressing Shift 5 times or holding Right Shift for 8 seconds no longer interrupts fullscreen apps.

bundles.display_name: Disable Mouse Acceleration ('Enhance Pointer Precision')
bundles.description: Disables Windows pointer acceleration curve so physical mouse movement maps 1:1 to screen pixels (ideal for gaming and CAD).
side_effects: Mouse cursor speed is linear; takes full effect after sign-out or reboot.

bundles.display_name: Disable Xbox Game DVR Background Recording & Controller Bar Hook
bundles.description: Disables background Game DVR video capture and stops the Xbox Guide button from launching the Game Bar overlay.
side_effects: Win+Alt+R background clip recording is disabled; reduces frame-time spikes in games.

bundles.display_name: Disable Window Maximize Hover Snap Layouts Flyout
bundles.description: Disables the Snap Layouts popup menu that appears when hovering the mouse over a window's Maximize button.
side_effects: Hovering over Maximize no longer triggers the Snap Layouts grid popup (Win+Z still works).

bundles.display_name: Prevent Automatic Windows Update Reboots While Logged In
bundles.description: Configures Windows Update policy so scheduled update installations never forcibly reboot the PC while a user is signed in.
side_effects: Pending security updates wait for you to manually restart.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Update Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Delivery Optimization
bundles.description: Sets Windows Update Delivery Optimization to HTTP-only (0) so your PC does not upload update chunks to other PCs on the LAN or Internet.
side_effects: Saves background upload bandwidth; updates download directly from Microsoft CDN.

bundles.display_name: Disable 'Get the latest updates as soon as they're available' Preview Toggle
bundles.description: Opts out of early non-security preview rollouts ('Continuous Innovation' waves) so only stable monthly cumulative updates are installed automatically.
side_effects: Preview feature rollouts wait until the regular Patch Tuesday release.

bundles.display_name: Prevent Automatic OEM Companion App Downloads on USB Plug-in
bundles.description: Stops Windows from automatically fetching OEM companion bloatware (e.g. Razer Synapse, HP Smart, Logitech stubs) when plugging in peripherals.
side_effects: Hardware drivers still install, but promotional OEM companion Store apps are not auto-installed.

bundles.display_name: Disable Fast Startup (Hybrid Hibernation) for Clean Boots
bundles.description: Disables Hiberboot so 'Shut down' performs a true full kernel shutdown instead of saving kernel state to hiberfil.sys.
side_effects: Fixes driver state bugs and dual-boot disk locks; cold boot takes 2-3 seconds longer.

bundles.display_name: Disable Network Activity During Modern Standby Sleep
bundles.description: Prevents Windows laptops from staying connected to Wi-Fi and draining battery or running updates while the lid is closed in Modern Standby (S0).
side_effects: Prevents overnight laptop battery drain and hot-bag wakeups.

bundles.display_name: Disable Automatic Storage Sense Background Sweeps
bundles.description: Disables automatic background Storage Sense runs so Windows does not automatically purge your Recycle Bin or Downloads folder.
side_effects: Temporary files and Downloads are only deleted when you manually clean them.

bundles.display_name: Remove Legacy WordPad Capability
bundles.description: Removes the deprecated Microsoft.Windows.WordPad~~~~0.0.1.0 Windows capability on builds prior to 24H2.
side_effects: WordPad (wordpad.exe) is removed; .rtf files must open in another editor.

bundles.display_name: Remove Legacy Steps Recorder & Math Input Panel Capabilities
bundles.description: Removes the deprecated Steps Recorder (psr.exe) and Math Input Panel optional capabilities via DISM.
side_effects: Steps Recorder (psr.exe) and Math Input Panel are unprovisioned.

bundles.display_name: Enable Windows Sandbox (Isolated Disposable VM)
bundles.description: Enables the built-in Windows Sandbox lightweight desktop virtualization feature on Pro/Enterprise editions.
side_effects: Requires hardware virtualization enabled in BIOS and a system reboot.

bundles.display_name: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux 2 (WSL + Virtual Machine Platform)
bundles.description: Enables both Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux and VirtualMachinePlatform via DISM so WSL 2 Linux distributions work out of the box.
side_effects: Requires hardware virtualization enabled in BIOS and a system reboot.

bundles.display_name: Enable Microsoft Hyper-V Virtualization Platform
bundles.description: Enables the full Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and management tools on Windows Pro/Enterprise/Education editions.
side_effects: Requires hardware virtualization in BIOS and a system reboot.

bundles.display_name: Enable .NET Framework 3.5 (Includes .NET 2.0 & 3.0)
bundles.description: Enables the legacy .NET Framework 3.5 runtime required by many older Win32 applications and games.
side_effects: Downloads and enables NetFx3 components via DISM.

bundles.display_name: Enable DirectPlay Legacy Gaming Component
bundles.description: Enables the DirectX DirectPlay optional feature required by classic late-90s and 2000s PC games.
side_effects: Enables LegacyComponents / DirectPlay via DISM.

bundles.display_name: Remove Microsoft Clipchamp Video Editor
bundles.description: Removes the preinstalled Clipchamp cloud video editor app for all users and deprovisions it from new user profiles.
side_effects: Clipchamp must be reinstalled from Microsoft Store if needed.

bundles.display_name: Remove MSN News and MSN Weather
bundles.description: Removes the preinstalled Microsoft News and Bing Weather UWP apps.
side_effects: Weather live tiles and Microsoft Start News app are removed.

bundles.display_name: Remove Bing Finance, Sports, Food, Health, Travel, Translator & Bing Search
bundles.description: Removes all remaining preinstalled Bing content apps (Money/Finance, Sports, Food & Drink, Health & Fitness, Travel, Translator, and Bing Search provider).
side_effects: Preinstalled Bing portal apps are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Microsoft Solitaire Collection
bundles.description: Removes the preinstalled Microsoft Solitaire Collection ad-supported game app and deprovisions it.
side_effects: Microsoft Solitaire Collection is uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove New Outlook & Personal Microsoft Teams
bundles.description: Removes the consumer Microsoft Teams (personal) app, legacy Teams stub, and the web-backed New Outlook app.
side_effects: Personal Teams chat integration and New Outlook mail client are removed; Enterprise Teams work/school app is unaffected.

bundles.display_name: Remove Cortana, Windows Tips (Get Started) & Feedback Hub
bundles.description: Removes the deprecated Cortana voice assistant app, Windows Tips ('Get Started'), and Windows Feedback Hub.
side_effects: Cortana, Tips, and Feedback Hub (Win+F) are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove 3D Builder, 3D Viewer, Paint 3D, Print 3D & Mixed Reality Portal
bundles.description: Removes legacy 3D modeling apps (3D Builder, 3D Viewer, Paint 3D, Print 3D) and the deprecated Windows Mixed Reality Portal.
side_effects: 3D Viewer, Paint 3D, and Mixed Reality Portal are removed (classic Paint is preserved).

bundles.display_name: Remove Microsoft 365 (Office) Hub, M365 Companions, Sway, Power BI & Journal
bundles.description: Removes the preinstalled Microsoft 365 promotional hub ('Office'), M365 Companions, Sway, Power BI, and Microsoft Journal.
side_effects: Does not affect full desktop Office/Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) installations.

bundles.display_name: Remove OneNote UWP, Sticky Notes, Microsoft To Do & Whiteboard
bundles.description: Removes the UWP Store versions of OneNote, Sticky Notes, Microsoft To Do, and Microsoft Whiteboard.
side_effects: Sticky Notes, To Do, and Whiteboard UWP apps are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Power Automate Desktop, PC Manager & Family Safety
bundles.description: Removes preinstalled Power Automate Desktop, Microsoft PC Manager, and Microsoft Family Safety apps.
side_effects: Power Automate Desktop and Family Safety apps are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Skype, People, Messaging, OneConnect & Legacy Mail/Calendar
bundles.description: Removes Skype UWP, People contact bar, Messaging SMS app, Paid Wi-Fi & Cellular (OneConnect), and legacy Mail & Calendar.
side_effects: Legacy UWP communication apps are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Windows Maps, Sound Recorder & Network Speed Test
bundles.description: Removes preinstalled Windows Maps, Windows Sound Recorder, and Network Speed Test apps.
side_effects: Offline Maps and Sound Recorder UWP apps are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Windows Camera & Alarms/Clock Apps
bundles.description: Removes the built-in Windows Camera and Windows Alarms & Clock (Focus Sessions) UWP apps.
side_effects: Built-in Camera app and Clock/Timer app are removed (webcams still work in Zoom/Teams/browsers).

bundles.display_name: Remove Phone Link (Your Phone) & Cross-Device Experience
bundles.description: Removes the Microsoft Phone Link app and the background Cross-Device Experience host.
side_effects: Android/iPhone Phone Link pairing and mobile camera integration are removed.

bundles.display_name: Remove Movies & TV (ZuneVideo) & Media Player (ZuneMusic)
bundles.description: Removes the Microsoft Movies & TV store video player and modern UWP Media Player.
side_effects: Media files will open in another installed player (e.g., VLC or legacy WMP).

bundles.display_name: Remove Xbox App, Xbox Game Bar & Overlays (Preserves Xbox Identity Provider)
bundles.description: Removes the Xbox Gaming App, Console Companion, and Xbox Game Bar overlays while preserving Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider so Store sign-in does not break.
side_effects: Xbox Game Pass app and Win+G Game Bar overlay are uninstalled.

bundles.display_name: Remove Third-Party Promoted Apps (Candy Crush, TikTok, Spotify, Disney+, Netflix, Prime Video, Social)
bundles.description: Removes third-party consumer apps and games commonly preinstalled or stubbed on Windows 10 and Windows 11 consumer editions.
side_effects: Uninstalls Candy Crush, Bubble Witch, TikTok, Spotify, Disney+, Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn UWP stubs.

bundles.display_name: Remove HP, Dell & Lenovo OEM Preinstalled Bloatware Suite
bundles.description: Removes preinstalled OEM promotional utilities and telemetry apps from HP (myHP, JumpStarts, Support Assistant), Dell (SupportAssist, Digital Delivery), and Lenovo (Vantage).
side_effects: OEM vendor companion apps are removed; hardware drivers and BIOS updates via Windows Update are unaffected.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Platform Binary Table (Block Motherboard BIOS Bloatware Injection)
bundles.description: Sets DisableWpbtExecution=1 so motherboard UEFI/BIOS firmware (ASUS Armoury Crate, Gigabyte Control Center, MSI, Razer) cannot inject executables into System32 at boot.
side_effects: Prevents UEFI firmware from auto-dropping OEM updater services into Windows on boot.

bundles.display_name: Disable Windows Consumer Features (Master Cloud-Suggested Apps Block)
bundles.description: Enables the CloudContent\DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures policy so Windows never auto-downloads third-party Store game/app stubs onto existing or newly created user accounts.
side_effects: Blocks automatic cloud provisioning of promoted Store apps.

bundles.display_name: Enable Win32 Long File Paths (> 260 Characters)
bundles.description: Removes the legacy 260-character MAX_PATH limitation for Win32 applications, Git repositories, Node.js, and Python toolchains.
side_effects: Manifest-aware Win32 applications and developer tools can access paths up to 32,767 characters.

bundles.display_name: Disable File Explorer Automatic Folder Type Discovery (Fix Slow Media Folders)
bundles.description: Locks File Explorer's default folder template to 'General Items' (NotSpecified) so opening a folder with images or MP3s does not stall for seconds switches columns.
side_effects: All folders use the fast General Items detail columns unless customized manually.

bundles.display_name: Set Non-Essential Background Services to Manual (Maps, Fax, RetailDemo, Xbox Save, Insider)
bundles.description: Configures rarely used background services (MapsBroker, Geolocation, Fax, RetailDemo, Windows Insider, Parental Controls, Wallet, Xbox Net/Save) to Manual startup so they use 0 RAM at boot without breaking on-demand features.
side_effects: Services only start when an application explicitly requests them.

bundles.display_name: Set Hardware BIOS Clock to UTC (Fix Linux Dual-Boot Time Drift)
bundles.description: Configures Windows to interpret the motherboard RTC hardware clock as UTC instead of local time, eliminating clock shifts when dual-booting Linux and Windows.
side_effects: System clock stays synchronized across Linux and Windows dual-boot systems.

bundles.display_name: Always Show Full Scrollbars in Windows 11 & UWP Apps
bundles.description: Disables auto-hiding thin scrollbars in Settings and WinUI/UWP apps so full scrollbars remain visible at all times.
side_effects: Scrollbars are always visible without needing to hover the mouse over the window edge.

bundles.display_name: Enable Verbose BSoD Stop Codes & Detailed Boot/Shutdown Status Messages
bundles.description: Displays full hexadecimal bugcheck parameters on Blue/Black Screens of Death and shows detailed service/policy names during sign-in and shutdown.
side_effects: Boot, shutdown, and crash screens display diagnostic status details.

bundles.display_name: Disable DWM Multiplane Overlay (MPO) to Fix GPU Flicker & Stutter
bundles.description: Sets DWM OverlayTestMode=5 to disable Multiplane Overlay composition, fixing black-screen flickering and stutter in Chromium/Discord/games on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
side_effects: Requires a system reboot to take effect.

bundles.display_name: Disable Background UWP Store Apps Globally (Save RAM & Laptop Battery)
bundles.description: Prevents Microsoft Store UWP apps from running background tasks and waking timers while their windows are closed.
side_effects: UWP Store apps (e.g. Mail, Weather, Alarms) will not refresh in the background when closed.

bundles.display_name: Prevent Microsoft Edge from Hijacking .PDF File Associations
bundles.description: Sets NoOpenWith and NoStaticDefaultVerb on MSEdgePDF so Windows Updates cannot silently reset your default PDF reader back to Microsoft Edge.
side_effects: Prevents Edge from taking over .pdf file associations.

bundles.display_name: Disable USB CEIP, Feedback SIUF & Error Reporting Queue Scheduled Tasks
bundles.description: Disables additional background telemetry tasks from Windows10Debloater/winutil: UsbCeip, SIUF DmClient feedback harvesters, and Windows Error Reporting QueueReporting.
side_effects: Background feedback prompts and crash queue uploads are disabled.

bundles.display_name: Block Automatic Razer Synapse & Logitech Companion Popups on USB Plug-in
bundles.description: Stops Windows Update driver metadata search from launching Razer Synapse / Logitech G-Hub installer popups when plugging in mice or keyboards.
side_effects: Peripheral HID drivers still work natively without auto-launching vendor bloatware installers.
